extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants to the Community of Writers 2026 Poetry and Writers Workshops (summer programs)
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative application and enrollment requirements for the Community of Writers' 2026 Poetry Workshop and Writers Workshops, including deadlines, fees, deposits, tuition, housing, and returnee rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadling to apply for 2026 Programs is March 10, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted by March 10, 2026 (before midnight PST). See guidelines for each program for any program-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program dates — Poetry Workshop
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Dates: June 22 - 28, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan availability for the full Poetry Workshop week starting Monday, June 22, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program dates — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Dates: July 10-17 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan availability for the full Writers Workshops week starting Friday, July 10, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Fee: $35
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Poetry application requires a $35 nonrefundable application fee at time of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Fee: $40
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Writers Workshops application requires a $40 nonrefundable application fee at time of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance notification — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptance Notification: On or before April 16, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants to the Poetry Workshop will be notified of acceptance on or before April 16, 2026; accepted applicants must follow deposit and registration timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance notification — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptance Notification: On or before April 22, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants to the Writers Workshops will be notified of acceptance on or before April 22, 2026; accepted applicants must follow deposit and registration timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit — Nonrefundable (amount & when due)
rubrics_metrics.description: A deposit of $1000 is due upon acceptance. (Awards of financial aid may reduce this amount.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The $1000 deposit is nonrefundable and required to hold a place upon acceptance; if financial aid is awarded the required deposit amount may be reduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit deadline — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Deposit Deadline: April 20, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted Poetry applicants must submit the nonrefundable deposit by April 20, 2026 to secure their place.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit deadline — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Deposit Deadline: May 1, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted Writers Workshops applicants must submit the nonrefundable deposit by May 1, 2026 to secure their place.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition: $1,750*
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poetry Workshop tuition is $1,750. Note: housing is not included in tuition; see Housing & Meals. The asterisk likely indicates additional notes (e.g., financial aid adjustments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition: $1900*
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers Workshops tuition is $1,900. Note: housing is not included in tuition; see Housing & Meals. The asterisk likely indicates additional notes (e.g., financial aid adjustments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Housing — general
rubrics_metrics.description: Housing: Not included in tuition. See Housing & Meals. CW-arranged lodging payment due May 15. / CW-arranged lodging payment due May 20.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must arrange or pay separately for housing. For CW-arranged lodging, Poetry-related payment is due May 15 and Writers Workshops lodging payment is due May 20; consult the Housing & Meals page for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition balance due — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition Balance: Due on or before June 12, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remaining tuition balance for Poetry Workshop must be paid on or before June 12, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition balance due — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition Balance: Due on or before July 1, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remaining tuition balance for Writers Workshops must be paid on or before July 1, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration / First Day — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration/First Day of Conference: Monday, June 22, 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should register and be present at the Poetry Workshop on Monday, June 22, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration / First Day — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration/First Day of Conference: Friday, July 10 2026
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should register and be present at the Writers Workshops on Friday, July 10, 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returnee policy — Fiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction Participants may attend 2 out of 3 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fiction applicants who are returning should note the attendance cap: they may attend two of any three consecutive years before needing to skip/comply with other rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returnee policy — Nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Nonfiction Participants must take two sessions off before reapplying.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nonfiction returning participants are required to sit out two program sessions before submitting a new application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation policy — Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: Cancellation Policy: Read Poetry Program Cancellation Policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and accepted participants must follow the Poetry Program's cancellation policy; consult the linked policy for refund and withdrawal terms (note: deposit is nonrefundable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation policy — Writers Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Cancellation Policy: Read Writers Workshops Week Cancellation Policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and accepted participants must follow the Writers Workshops Week cancellation policy; consult the linked policy for refund and withdrawal terms (note: deposit is nonrefundable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial aid & scholarships
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial Aid & Scholarships: View Financial Aid Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial aid and scholarship options are available and may affect deposit amount and tuition obligations; applicants should review the program's financial aid information and apply as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application forms / submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Form: Poetry Application Form / Writers Workshops Application Form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must complete the appropriate application form for the Poetry Workshop or Writers Workshops; follow form-specific instructions and submit by the stated deadline along with the application fee and any requested materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returning Poetry lottery
rubrics_metrics.description: Returning Poetry Lottery Information & Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific process exists for returning Poetry applicants via a lottery system; returning poets should consult the Returning Poetry Lottery information and application for eligibility and procedure.
